doubts: Y1: the measure (test reward or win rate over 1,280 episodes after training) is given, but the number of training runs behind each value is never stated. Y2/Y11: every table reports ± values and the figures show bands, but nothing says what they represent. Y4: the RDC variants beat Base everywhere; the only loss shown is to the delay-free Oracle at zero delay. Y5: the delay baselines are said to be reimplemented in the RDC framework, but the source of the FT-QMIX/FT-VDN code is only implied by the RDC-pymarl repository. Y9: history_length is a training parameter in Table 2 and is swept in Figure 12, but the paper presents it as an input-design comparison rather than as a hyperparameter.
